description: This file defines a custom exception class UnrewindableStreamException used within the Laminas Diactoros package, specifically under the Exception namespace. It extends RuntimeException and provides a static method for creating instances related to callback stream errors.

classes.name: UnrewindableStreamException
classes.description: A specialized exception thrown when a stream cannot be rewound, particularly in the context of callback streams.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns an instance of UnrewindableStreamException with a specific message indicating callback streams cannot be rewinded.
